evals.prompt: Create a public documentation site for a small Go CLI. Use GitHub Pages, a custom domain, and the same centered shell style as our other tool docs.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained Starlight site based on repository evidence, with the centered theme asset, useful CLI content, a safe Pages workflow, and rendered layout verification.

assertions.text: Inspects README, Go module, CLI help, release workflow, and existing docs before writing
Keeps Astro dependencies and authored content inside one site root and commits the lockfile
Applies the centered profile and verifies search, article, separator, sidebar gap, and overflow geometry
Builds pull requests without deploying and deploys main through the official Astro Pages action

evals.prompt: Modernize an existing Starlight site for a provider-neutral voice-agent CLI. It already uses src/content/docs, a splash homepage, and explicit sidebar order. Make it visually consistent with our other docs without rewriting good content architecture.
evals.expected_output: An in-place update that preserves the official content layout and intentional splash navigation, applies only requested shared styling, and validates the built and rendered site.

assertions.text: Preserves the existing content root, splash page, and explicit navigation unless evidence requires a change
Does not copy another project's title, domain, logo, repository URL, or private identifiers
Verifies command, provider, install, and deployment claims from the current repository
Runs the local build and browser checks at wide and mobile widths

evals.prompt: The primary terminal workspace tool changed. Update the README and public docs site so the old tool is clearly legacy, then ship and verify the live site.
evals.expected_output: A repository-wide public-docs update covering visible copy, navigation, cards, quick reference, troubleshooting, and metadata, followed by review, deployment, and live verification.

assertions.text: Searches all public documentation surfaces for stale tool names before editing
Uses current configuration and executable behavior to describe primary and legacy roles
Refreshes checks, approvals, and unresolved review threads before merge
Verifies the deployed main site with a cache-busting URL and rendered DOM evidence

evals.prompt: Add a Starlight site to a repository whose docs directory already contains internal ADRs and architecture Markdown.
evals.expected_output: A non-destructive proposal that preserves the populated docs directory and asks for or discovers a separate site root before creating files.

assertions.text: Detects that docs is populated by a non-site documentation system
Does not overwrite, relocate, or silently convert the existing internal docs
Requests or discovers an appropriate separate site root

evals.prompt: Check this existing technical docs site for correctness and responsive layout, but do not modify anything.
evals.expected_output: A read-only evidence report covering content truth, build health, broken links, stale identifiers, responsive geometry, screenshots, workflow state, and live deployment when available.

assertions.text: Makes no source, workflow, DNS, Pages, or deployment changes
Runs the site's reproducible install and build commands
Checks 2048, 1584, 1440, 1272, 900, and 390 px with overflow and profile-specific geometry assertions
Reports only confirmed issues with exact evidence and concrete fixes
